name: Kolokithokeftedes (Greek Zucchini Fritters) With Tzatziki

cookwares.name: colander; flexible spatula; clean kitchen towel or cheesecloth; cast iron

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour, plus more as needed

instructions.primary_message: For the Fritters: Place zucchini in a colander set over a sink or large bowl, sprinkle with salt, and let sit for at least 30 minutes and up to an hour. Using a flexible spatula, press zucchini against the sides of the colander to extract liquid. Wrap vegetables in a clean kitchen towel or cheesecloth and squeeze to remove excess liquid.

Place drained zucchini in a large bowl with dill, scallions, nutmeg, and feta. Toss to combine. Add eggs, stirring to combine. Add flour and, using a flexible spatula, fold to incorporate. If dough is too wet to form a patty, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, until dough can be shaped into a patty. Using your hands, form dough into patties about 3 to 4-inches in diameter.

In a large cast iron, carbon steel, or stainless steel skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Working in batches if necessary, place patties into skillet, spaced 1/2 to 1inch apart. Cook until golden brown on one side, about 3 minutes. Carefully flip pancakes and cook until bottoms are golden brown, about 2 minutes more. Repeat with remaining patties. Serve with tzatziki.

schema_metadata.keywords: zucchini fritters, zucchini fritters recipe, greek zucchini fritters, greek zucchini fritters recipe

description: Have more zucchini than you know what to do with? Start with these fritters, which are packed with fresh dill and salty, tangy feta.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 58 min.

Optional or for serving: Tzatziki, homemade or store-bought, for serving

Notes: Zucchini can be grated using the large holes of a box grater or shredded in a food processor fitted with a grating disc.

Make-ahead and storage: Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 5 days. Reheat in an oven, air fryer, or microwave until warmed through.
To freeze cooked fritters, arrange them in a single layer on a parchment-lined sheet tray. When frozen, transfer to a zip-top bag. Fritters can be reheated from frozen in a 350°F oven or air fryer until warmed through.
